referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Joe Hall Roofing and Contracting homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a broad roof aerial under a centered white mission statement with the roof texture still visible. It uses crisp white and charcoal service row with a green inspection control. The visual system relies on tall condensed uppercase headlines with restrained body copy; surfaces include white, charcoal, mint green and accents include saturated green, pale mint. Imagery is roof aerial, team group portrait, and local building context. The page then runs through roof aerial mission hero, local introduction, residential and commercial pair, affiliation band, team portrait and story, recognition and review bands, social work and dark contact footer. Its service presentation is two spacious icon-led service columns for residential and commercial work. Mobile changes to keep the roof aerial and mission readable, stack the two services, and move team photo below its explanation. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy Joe Hall mark, mission wording, team portrait, awards, affiliations, specific years, roof imagery, or reviews.
